visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with dark hair tied back sits on a teal padded bench inside a small train carriage. She is wearing a blue denim-style dress and holds a white handheld electric fan to her forehead with her right hand. The background shows a light green interior with large windows looking out onto a grassy outdoor area. (2) The camera pans to show the interior ceiling of the carriage, which features metal luggage racks and light green plastic hanging straps for passengers. A small security camera is mounted in the corner. The setting is bright and appears to be a tourist-oriented mini train. (3) The girl is seen moving around on the bench, then sitting next to a man wearing glasses and a blue shirt who is making a 'V' sign. The girl imitates the gesture, looking into the camera with a playful and slightly curious facial expression. (4) The scene shifts to the exterior where a small, vintage-style orange and yellow locomotive is parked on narrow tracks near green trees. The lighting is natural daylight under a clear sky, highlighting the bright colors of the train and the surrounding environment. (5) The girl is now outdoors in an open-air plaza with water fountains spraying from the ground. She walks barefoot on the tiled surface, which is wet and reflective. She plays with a manual water pump and a small orange plastic ball, appearing highly engaged and joyful as water splashes around her. (6) A final animated screen appears on a solid pink background, showing a cartoon illustration of the girl holding an orange, with the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE' centered below the graphic.
